estimator: centre on the full pool at the posterior means; intervals are the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles over a cluster bootstrap by syndicate with one posterior draw per replicate (a conditional resampling interval, not the posterior interval of vignette_uncertainty_results.json)
note: size_only = size + floor operator (the headline); overlay = size + concentration + floor

size_only.operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma = 0 in the transfer, set to zero in every retained posterior draw (and in the posterior mean) of the adopted gamma-inclusive fit; k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC keep their fitted values; not a refit. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero

overlay.operator_construction: concentration overlay: the fitted concentration exponent gamma (each posterior draw, or the posterior mean) in the transfer; a labelled sensitivity, not the headline

overlay_relative_to_headline.note: overlay centre / headline centre - 1: what switching the concentration overlay on does

headline_relative_to_overlay.note: headline centre / overlay centre - 1: what switching the concentration overlay off does
